pattern.comment: 1. Intro: Moody dark pads, deep vocal atmosphere, and sparse hi-hats (4 bars)
pattern.label: intro

pattern.comment: 2. Classic Dubstep pre-drop vocal chant right before the bass hits
pattern.label: preDropVocal

pattern.comment: 2. Build-up: Accelerating snare roll, rising pitch synth, and pre-drop vocal (4 bars)
pattern.label: buildSection

pattern.comment: 4. Breakdown: Bass cuts out; eerie pads and high haunting synth notes return (4 bars)
pattern.label: breakdown

vocalAtmos.comment: 1. Eerie, pitched-down vocal atmosphere for the intro & breakdown
vocalAtmos.label: vocalAtmos

pattern.comment: Heavy half-time Dubstep beat (Kick on 1, Snare on 3)
pattern.label: dubstepDrums

pattern.comment: 1. Pure, chest-rattling sine wave sub-bass (stays clean below 100 Hz)
pattern.label: subBass

pattern.comment: 2. Aggressive mid-range wobble bass with changing LFO speeds per bar
pattern.label: wobbleBass

drop.comment: 3. Drop: Half-time drums, pure sub-bass, and dynamic wobble bass (8 bars)
drop.label: drop
